notes.title: Asemblance will be made permanently free for Steam users on June 2nd 2025
Dread Central give Asemblance "Art Game of the Year"
notes.notes:
Ted Hentschke of [url=http://www.dreadcentral.com/]Dread Central[/url] announced that Asemblance was his Art Game of the Year!!

We're really excited about this and very much apprectiate the continued coverage that we've recieved from Dread Central.

We also sat down with Ted (over the phone) for an interview and talked about the development of Asemblance, our inspirations, and where we want to take the next episodes in the serier.

You can read more here:
http://www.dreadcentral.com/news/182908/arts-sake-interview-team-nilo-asemblance-art-game-year/

Cheers!
Niles
